stages.name: topic-search
stages.desc: User types topic; search YouTube for how-to videos; return titles, links, Show-transcript availability. STOP for confirm (unless ongoing distillery authorized).

stages.name: save-raw
stages.desc: After confirm, pull YouTube Show-transcript text only (info → Transcript); save as raw/<id>/transcript.txt + raw.txt. Use pipeline/fetch_youtube_transcript.py.

stages.name: distill
stages.desc: Apply distill-transcript skill on transcript prose; remove filler; keep actionable steps/facts.

stages.name: summary-destination
stages.desc: User started saying In… — wait for exact summary output location/format before finalizing.

stages.name: skills-curriculums
stages.desc: Emit executable skills; place in topics; sequence into curriculums toward human-level generality.

guiding_purpose: Build an agent that can do anything a human can do, by learning from YouTube how-to videos through their available transcripts (not raw pixels), continuously expanding executable skills, workflows, and curriculums toward that trajectory.
